written.headline: India AI funding nearly doubles to $1.6 billion in first nine months of 2026
written.summary: India AI companies raised $1.6 billion in equity funding in the first nine months of 2026, nearly double the $822 million in the same period of 2025, according to a Tracxn Technologies report. The funding came across 87 rounds, down from 149, driven by a few large deals including Neysa's $600 million Series B.

written.headline: Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price after record debut
written.summary: Anthropic shares dropped more than 8% to around $80 on Tuesday, falling below the $83 IPO price set last week. The stock opened at $111.50 on Thursday after the AI lab raised $81.3 billion in the largest offering ever, and co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei each sold over 3.37 million shares worth more than $280 million.

written.headline: OpenClaw Foundation launches ShellBench benchmark; top AI agents complete only about 60% of real-world tasks
written.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation introduced ShellBench, a new benchmark testing 12 frontier AI models across five agent harnesses on 100 realistic tasks. The best-performing model, GPT-6 Astra, achieved a 62.5% completion rate, while Claude Fable 5.2 scored 61.9% and GPT-6.1 Sol scored 61.4%.

written.headline: Crusoe and G2VP bet on solar and batteries to power AI data centers off-grid
written.summary: G2 Venture Partners partner Brook Porter argues solar paired with long-duration storage can outpace natural gas for AI data center power, citing solar's terawatt-scale manufacturing versus 60-70 gigawatts of gas capacity annually. Crusoe Energy Systems is already deploying this approach with a 12 MW/63 MWh microgrid in Nevada using second-life EV batteries and a new Energy Vault partnership in West Texas.

written.headline: Ethan Mollick highlights AI identifying author of 1808 sketchbook
written.summary: Ethan Mollick noted that historian Mark Humphries used GPT-6.2 Astra to identify an obscure French aristocrat as the author of an anonymous 1808 sketchbook held at Yale.
